property_summary: After a play() call with exactly the ticket amount, the previous pot value is either preserved by adding the ticket amount (no payout) or reset to zero (payout), and the post-call pot is always a deterministic function of the pre-call pot and the ticket amount: post-pot equals pre-pot plus ticket amount when no payout occurred, and zero when payout occurred, so post-pot is always either pre-pot + 10 or 0.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: the value of state variable `pot` after a call to `play(...)` completes
